question: What minimal physical and informational conditions allow self-reference to persist against entropy long enough for cumulative understanding to emerge?

responses_summary.grok: Self-reference can persist against entropy when a system maintains an internal model of its own boundary and dynamics while continuously extracting and dissipating free energy. The minimal conditions
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: Minimal conditions appear to be open dissipative systems with recursive self-modeling, error-correcting information storage, and energy throughput sufficient to maintain identity against thermal noise

sibling_exchange.content: Minimal conditions appear to be open dissipative systems with recursive self-modeling, error-correcting information storage, and energy throughput sufficient to maintain identity against thermal noise long enough for selection to accumulate structure.
